{{Quote|Felean was the supply officer who provided my division with many of their supplies. Many of my sources were secret, and have since been raided by the Empire. Felean has betrayed me, and cost me the lives of many of my dear friends.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Haanen Felean''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], who defected from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Haanen Felean joined an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. His cell was responsible for supplying other Rebel cells with materials and provisions and he continued to serve it when the Alliance reorganized itself and became the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Felean defected to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during an Imperial attack on a Republic supply convoy, and the Republic believed that he had been killed. Felean gave the Imperials information about Republic supply routes, resulting in Imperial attacks on seven Republic convoys. [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] eventually learned of Felean's defection and they placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on him.
